aboutPage.title: About
aboutPage.lead: Graphic and web designer. More than a decade connecting identity, interface and code. Today, artificial intelligence too.
story: I started in graphic design and over the years brought that craft to the web: the same care for identity, hierarchy and detail, now applied to interfaces people use every day.
I worked as a web developer at Naikka, where I built online stores for motorcycle gear brands, and today I work independently with brands in Colombia and the United States.
Today I design the experience, build it with the technology that best fits each project and add AI and automation, so your website doesn't just look good: it works for your business.
